newsitem.title: USA: Horace Mann Educators Q4 operating net climbs.
newsitem.headline: Horace Mann Educators Q4 operating net climbs.

text.p: Horace Mann Educators Corp said increased underwriting and expense control helped operating income reach $0.91 a share in the fourth-quarter ended December 31, compared with $0.86 one year ago.
Operating income totaled $21.5 million in the period, versus $20.2 million in the fourth quarter last year, Horace Mann Educators said.
The company said pretax catastrophe losses totaled $20.9 million for 1996, compared with $13.9 million in 1995.
Horace Mann Educators sells retirement annuities, aurtomobile, homeowners and life insurance to educators.
Its shares were trading up 1/2 Tuesday at 41-5/8.
